title: Sign in to Skyclause
sent: Sign-in link sent to {email}. Check your email to finish signing in.
sent_resend: New sign-in link sent. Check your email.
passkey_failed: Passkey sign-in didn’t finish. Try again or use email sign-in.
google_failed: Google sign-in didn’t finish. Try Google again or use email sign-in.
google_start_failed: Google sign-in couldn’t start. Try again or use email sign-in.
send_failed: The sign-in link wasn’t sent. Check the address and try again.
send_rate_limited: Too many link requests. Wait a while, then try again.
confirm_failed: This link couldn’t be confirmed. Return to the original tab and choose Send again.
confirm_done: Confirmed. Return to the tab and choose Send again.
link_expired: This link has expired. Request a new one.
link_expired_step_up: This link has expired. Go back to the tab that requested it and choose Send again.
link_pending: This Google account isn’t linked to Skyclause. Use email sign-in for this account.
resend_failed: A new link wasn’t sent. Check the original tab and try again.
